newsitem.title: JORDAN: Indonesian President Suharto arrives in Jordan.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian President Suharto arrives in Jordan.

text.p: Indonesia's President Suharto arrived in Jordan on Monday for a state visit during which the two countries are expected to sign agreements to increase economic cooperation.
Suharto was met on arrival by King Hussein and Crown Prince Hassan, witnesses said.

Jordan's official Petra news agency said on Friday that during Suharto's stay ministers would sign agreements regarding investment guarantees, prevention of dual taxation and maritime tranport between the two countries.
After his trip to Jordan Suharto is due to visit Italy where he will attend the World Food Summit in Rome.
